dataset: LOL-v1 official archive; full eval15 untouched for grid selection
dev: our485/2.png (lowest numeric training ID, feasibility only)
rationale: Preselect 128 vs 256, same nominal 50% overlap; avoid choosing the best score on eval15. Positive Hann floor 0.001.
edge_metric: mean absolute RGB residual on +/-2 pixel band around union of BOTH grids' interior tile starts/ends, in uint8 levels; identical mask for all arms
resource_stop: Skip expansion on allocation failure, process peak RSS > 8 GiB or > 180 s per 600x400 image; preserve failures.
bench: 111.png; each arm in a fresh process, one warmup then five measured runs; no other inference concurrently
